verdict.rationale: DGX B200 exposes some programmatic management surfaces (Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, nvidia-smi CLI, DCGM) alongside a web UI/KVM for system administration, suggesting some overlap between UI and API/CLI capabilities for hardware management tasks. However, there is no explicit documentation asserting full feature parity between the UI and API for all administrative or AI workflow tasks, and no independent verification of this parity. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement between UI and API, coverage beyond basic health/power monitoring, and community/hands-on confirmation that all UI actions are API-accessible.
